news.body: After last week's 15% share price decline to ₹641, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 22.7x. Average trailing P/E is 16x in the Construction industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 1,040% over the past three years.

news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: Following the recent departure of a director, there are only 2 independent directors on the board. The company's board is composed of: 2 independent directors. 4 non-independent directors. Independent Director Sneha Varma was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2022. The company's minority of independent directors is a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹7.56 (vs ₹3.53 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹7.56 (up from ₹3.53 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.19b (up 229% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹79.1m (up 130% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 6.7% (down from 9.5% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 77% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 141% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
